output.reason: A 6-month-old with reported fever, fussiness, reduced feeding interest and fewer wet diapers than normal needs hands-on hydration and perfusion assessment, weight, and possible urine testing today, which messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Please have her seen in person today — urgent care, pediatric same-day care, or the emergency department. Fever with poor feeding and fewer wet diapers needs hands-on checks for dehydration and a possible urine infection. Offer small, frequent feeds meanwhile. Call 911 or go now if she becomes limp, hard to wake, has trouble breathing, cool/mottled skin, or a new spreading rash.
differential: Viral febrile illness with reduced intake and early dehydration
Occult urinary tract infection or other bacterial source
